method: Chrome (headless, frame rate limit and vsync off), a fresh page per sample; esbuild production build with code splitting; input is a synthetic pointermove dispatched a set delay after createChart returns; drawn runs to the tooltip's box being shown (a MutationObserver), frame to the animation frame after; caches: cold (HTTP cache disabled), warm (chunks cached by an earlier load), slow (cold, 100 ms added latency)
